title: American Center of Research Fellowships 2027–2028
field: Archaeology, humanities and social sciences of Jordan and the region
level: Graduate students and postdoctoral scholars (varies by award)
about: The American Center of Research in Amman offers fellowships, scholarships and awards for research connected to Jordan, including the Kenneth W. Russell Fellowship and a new Clark Student Travel/Research Scholarship. Applications for the 2027-2028 cycle are due February 15, 2027.
requirements: Eligibility varies by award; several awards require U.S. citizenship and enrolment at a U.S. institution
The Kenneth W. Russell Fellowship is open to graduate students of any nationality except Jordanian

upskill.name: Prompt Engineering for Research & Knowledge Work
why: Purpose 'research connected to Jordan' → objective 'Design prompts for reviewing literature, identifying themes, extracting research information, and comparing findings across multiple sources.'

card_alt: Card for the American Center of Research Fellowships 2027–2028 offered by the American Center of Research (ACOR), Amman, Jordan, with a 15 Feb 2027 deadline. The photo shows the rock-cut Monastery (Ad Deir) at Petra in southern Jordan, not Amman.
